# Fairlady Salon

> Hair salon based in Pflugerville, Texas. Balayage, color correction, curls and precision cuts in Pflugerville since 2006, starting with an essential-oil wash and an aromatherapy towel that clients call the best part.

- Phone: (512) 670-0838

## Services
- Balayage & highlights: Hand-painted balayage, partial highlights, face framing and babylights in caramel, honey, mocha and blonde.
- Color & color correction: Root touch-ups, rich brunettes, cherry cola and vivid shades, plus color correction when a past color went wrong.
- Cuts & pixies: Precision cuts for women and men, done neatly and without rushing, including the short cuts that are hard to get right.
- Curls & perms: Expert care for curly, thick or fine hair, plus perms and relaxers with a stylist who asks the right questions first.
- Brazilian Blowout & keratin: Every Fairlady stylist is Brazilian Blowout certified. Smoothing for frizz-free, shiny hair that is easier to style.
- Wash & treatments: Our signature essential-oil wash and aromatherapy towel, with deep conditioning and repair treatments.

## About
Fairlady Salon has been doing hair in Pflugerville since 2006. Owner Vilma Lopez leads the team from 1202 FM 685, under the blue Fairlady sign. Inside it's black leather chairs, marble floors and glass mosaic tile, and clients describe it as serene, chic and spa-like from the moment they walk in. We're the home of color correction and balayage specialists, with expert care for curly, thick or fine hair. Fairlady is a Redken salon, every stylist is Brazilian Blowout certified, and walk-ins are welcome. Our stylists explain your hair type and its condition, suggest what will suit you, and take their time so everything is done properly.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What services do you offer?
  A: Balayage and highlights, roots and all-over color, color correction and vivids, haircuts for women and men including pixies, curly cuts, perms and relaxers, Brazilian Blowout and keratin smoothing, and treatments with our signature essential-oil wash.
- Q: How much does a visit cost?
  A: Our starting prices are on the services page, for example a women's cut and style from $47 and balayage from $130. Prices go up with length, density and stylist level, so your stylist confirms the total at your consultation. Services of $125 or more need a 25% deposit when you book.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To be sure of your stylist and time, especially for color, call (512) 670-0838 or book online any time, and send an inspiration photo if you have one.
- Q: Do you work with curly or short hair?
  A: Yes. Clients come to us for curly cuts and color, perms, and pixie cuts. Tell us about your hair when you book and we'll plan the right appointment.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday 10 AM to 7 PM, Tuesday 9 AM to 7 PM, Wednesday 10 AM to 7 PM, Thursday and Friday 9 AM to 8 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM (VIP appointments from 7:30 AM), closed Sunday. We close for Good Friday, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day and New Year's Eve.
- Q: Where is Fairlady Salon?
  A: 1202 FM 685, Suite B-1, Pflugerville, TX 78660, under the blue Fairlady sign. It's an easy drive from Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Manor and Wells Branch.
